title: Stripe stability boundaries in two dimensions
question: For the cubic Swift–Hohenberg equation on a two-dimensional torus, classify sideband instabilities of a specified stripe family.
first_test: Derive the Bloch eigenvalue expansion and the sharp Eckhaus-type boundary.

title: Hexagon versus stripe selection
question: For a quadratic-cubic Swift–Hohenberg extension, determine when hexagonal patterns minimize energy relative to stripes.
first_test: Prove a weakly nonlinear energy comparison with error control.

title: Pattern pinning by weak heterogeneity
question: Determine whether a small periodic substrate force selects a discrete set of translated stripe phases.
first_test: Prove pinning intervals and their dependence on forcing amplitude.

title: Defect mobility laws
question: Derive a reduced motion law for a single phase dislocation in a slowly evolving two-dimensional stripe pattern.
first_test: Justify an effective mobility coefficient and error estimate.

title: Disorder-induced wavelength shift
question: Quantify how a small random or deterministic spatial modulation changes the selected wave number of a stable pattern.
first_test: Prove a deterministic perturbation bound or a stochastic limiting law.

title: Coarsening exponent classification
question: For a fixed class of scalar pattern-forming gradient flows, determine whether defect density decays with a common algebraic exponent.
first_test: Prove an exponent in a controlled regime or demonstrate nonuniversality.

title: Finite-box versus infinite-plane pattern selection
question: Determine whether preferred wave numbers on growing periodic tori converge to those selected by the whole-plane dynamics.
first_test: Prove a thermodynamic-limit statement or show dependence on box sequence.

title: Localized patches of periodic structure
question: Determine whether bounded spots of periodic stripes can coexist with a homogeneous background as stationary fourth-order states.
first_test: Construct a spatially localized patch and prove its spectral stability.

title: Front speed between competing patterns
question: Classify propagation speed and direction of fronts connecting distinct periodic equilibria in a Swift–Hohenberg-type gradient flow.
first_test: Construct a heteroclinic front and establish a speed-selection criterion.

title: Phase diffusion coefficient sign changes
question: Determine how nonlinear amplitude affects the phase-diffusion coefficient of a stripe branch near onset.
first_test: Calculate the leading coefficient and locate its sign-change threshold.

title: Nonlinear pattern selection under slow parameter ramps
question: When a bifurcation parameter varies slowly in time, determine whether the final wavelength tracks the instantaneous stable band.
first_test: Prove adiabatic tracking or hysteresis with sharp ramp scaling.

title: Stochastic creation of phase dislocations
question: For a weakly noisy pattern-forming PDE, quantify the rate of defect-pair nucleation from a spectrally stable stripe.
first_test: Establish a large-deviation barrier or a zero-rate obstruction.

title: Pattern inheritance across interfaces
question: For two adjoining media with distinct preferred wavelengths, determine which stationary grain-boundary configurations have finite interfacial energy.
first_test: Construct a compatible interface or prove an incompatibility bound.

title: Aperiodic stable textures
question: Determine whether quasiperiodic or aperiodic stationary patterns can be orbitally stable in a local fourth-order scalar PDE.
first_test: Produce a stable aperiodic example or prove rigidity under a stated condition.

title: Gradient-flow convergence rates
question: Determine sharp convergence rates to a stationary pattern for initial data near a degenerate equilibrium of a fourth-order gradient flow.
first_test: Prove a Łojasiewicz–Simon rate and construct sharp cases.

title: Topological defect charge balance
question: For a smooth complex amplitude description of stripes, derive conservation laws for signed phase-dislocation charge while defects remain isolated.
first_test: Prove charge balance through nucleation and annihilation events.

title: Pattern memory after forcing removal
question: Determine whether a transient spatial forcing can leave a stable wavelength or orientation change after it is removed.
first_test: Establish a permanent switch under an explicit forcing protocol.

title: Coupled pattern synchronization
question: For two weakly coupled Swift–Hohenberg fields, classify stable phase-locked stripe solutions and synchronization thresholds.
first_test: Prove existence and stability or show phase slips prevent locking.

title: Anisotropic grain-boundary energy
question: Derive the minimal interfacial energy between stripes with two prescribed orientations for a fourth-order pattern functional.
first_test: Prove existence of a minimizing boundary and angular asymptotics.
